inputs.prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A continuous ten-second cinematic LIVE-ACTION fight between the SAME TWO adult human stunt actors from Picture 1, in the same sunlit ruined courtyard. Masked Scorpion in practical yellow-and-black LEFT; masked Sub-Zero in practical blue-and-black RIGHT. Preserve their human faces, proportions, hooded costumes, wet fabric, stone stairs and timber columns. The starting picture is the exact last frame of the preceding shot: Scorpion is frozen in attached ice and Sub-Zero is in guard. Fixed medium-wide side view, both complete bodies and grounded feet visible. Real-time fast combat, tense concentration, aggressive intentions, credible stunt weight. The actors take the fight seriously while their supernatural powers are spectacular.

OPENING, about 0–2 seconds: Scorpion clenches his fists and drives his elbows outward. ORANGE HELLFIRE blooms tightly around HIS hands and forearms, breaks the ice attached to his torso and frees both arms in one forceful burst. Fragments fall, meltwater splashes and steam briefly rises. His mask and hood remain on and his costume remains wet. He steps straight into striking range as the fragments fall. Sub-Zero tracks him, braces his feet and raises his forearm guard. The camera immediately sees human combat after the ice breaks.

PRESSURE, about 2–5 seconds: Scorpion drives a quick left jab into Sub-Zero's raised forearm, retracts it immediately and follows with a right cross. Sub-Zero turns his shoulder and catches the cross on his opposite forearm. His upper body recoils at the block and his rear foot catches the weight. While Scorpion retracts, Sub-Zero rotates his hips and drives a short right punch at Scorpion's ribs. Scorpion turns his body, absorbs that punch on a lowered elbow, recoils a half-step and immediately returns his guard. Hands strike, touch and separate quickly. Neither fighter stands waiting for the other.

ELEMENTAL COUNTER, about 5–8 seconds: Sub-Zero closes the half-step with his lead boot. BLUE-WHITE ICE crystallizes tightly around HIS LEFT FIST and forearm as he drives a compact straight punch at Scorpion's upper chest. Scorpion catches it across his two forearms in front of his chest. The real blue fist makes visible contact with the yellow fighter's forearm guard; the force instantly pushes Scorpion's shoulders and hips backward and his rear boot plants to stop the recoil. Frost spreads briefly from that contact onto Scorpion's blocking forearms. Scorpion forcefully tears those forearms apart with an orange flare, breaking that thin frost. He rotates his hips, pushes from the rear boot and immediately returns a RIGHT FIRE PUNCH toward Sub-Zero's chest. Sub-Zero crosses his own forearms to block it. Scorpion's real fist lands on the crossed guard: orange flame hits blue-white ice AT THAT CONTACT, brittle ice shards and steam burst away, and Sub-Zero is knocked backward one catching step. Both actors' bodies react to the actual contact; sparks and shards follow that movement. The short effects stay attached to their owners' moving hands and disperse after impact.

ENDING, about 8–10 seconds: Sub-Zero plants his catching foot, sweeps aside the returning yellow arm and immediately begins a counterpunch as Scorpion pivots to meet it. End during this active exchange, both men upright and intent on each other. Follow-through, clothing and falling fragments remain in motion. Solid normal stone footing throughout; neither fighter attempts a floor trick. Scorpion owns orange fire; Sub-Zero owns blue-white cold and ice. Two human fighters only, no added weapons. One uninterrupted shot at normal speed, no slow motion, comic posing, laughter or glance at the camera. No blood.

overall_soundscape: Synchronized cracking ice and a brief fire rush at the escape, falling ice and meltwater, quick cloth movement, planted footfalls, hard compact punch and forearm-block impacts, a short cold crack on the ice-fist block and a steam hiss when the fire punch hits the frozen guard. Courtyard wind. No speech, vocalizations, laughter or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.

_meta.title: T02 R3 — upright fire/ice counter exchange, serious intention
